choices.b2_label: B2's 'for less than Opus's price' applies when the cost ratio is above 10 (k.json's capped = ratio > 10, set by study1b_k and re-checked here); at a ratio of exactly 10, k = 10 with 'about Opus-medium's price'.
choices.bootstrap_names: §4 per-form intervals '1b:<test>:<N>:<form>:<h|o|v|d>'; the vote curve '1b:hx-vote:16:<form|pooled>'; <arm> in '1b:<arm>:<N>:...' is the tag (hx, om, ...); <form> is the shape (16x1, 1x16).
choices.completeness_gate: lock-4 audit A1 (Edith's ruling): a test is completed only if every designed try (request sent) of hx and om in its set has a final record; else it reads 'not completed' in every view and margin, p = 1 in its Holm place, §10's not-completed line (m, n over both arms), no error-rate ratio, per-form numbers on its final tries only labelled 'not completed; descriptive only'; the D-97 sensitivity uses the run's gate. If k < 1, B2 reads 'not run'.
choices.cost_per_answer: item 9b's base_costs / cost_block (a designed try with no record at $0, X4), pooled = per-base mean of the two forms; k itself uses the mean over real calls (cost-only rows), as §4 says. The '1/k' wording uses k.json's k for B1 and B2, and floor(om / hx cost per answer at N = 6) for B3.
choices.cpc_seed: item 9c's CPC and 9b's cost intervals come from report_costs (locked), which draws with its own seed 20261012 and names 'cpc:<tag>:<shape>' / 'cost_mean:<tag>:<shape>'; the pooled CPC is named 'cpc:<tag>:<N>:pooled'.
choices.error_ratio_seed: main_analysis.ratio_from_errors (locked, item 1) is called with its module seed set to 20261013 for the call and restored after, so the draws are Random(derive_seed(20261013, f'{test}:error_ratio')).
choices.error_ratio_zero: Opus 0 errors: the Clopper-Pearson bound replaces the locked one (which uses the number of bases) with n = the test's designed Opus tries (bases x 2 forms x 2); the locked over-bases value is kept beside it.
choices.exclude_missing_view: item 16 / D-48 row 23 as Study 1 (report_arms.exclude_missing_view): as_deployed with only kind 'missing' left out (singles over the tries left, the vote with designed=0 so k is held to what is left), both margins, same k, B, seeds and Holm; computed only if a try of hx or om at N = 16 or 6 is missing. Its Holm family holds a test not completed at p = 1 (so a completed test equals the main view); such a test gets d, a cluster-bootstrap interval (2,000 draws) and the bases used on its final tries, 'not completed; descriptive only', never a reading (spec §4, D-103(F); Edith L-1).
choices.headline_template: §10's template per test: 'holds' only if no worse in all three views; 'inconclusive' / 'worse' from the as-deployed reading; an as-deployed 'no worse' that fails another view is reported as such (no §10 template).
choices.inputs_required: Study 1's analysis.json and the ladder's D-87 curve file must exist (§6 draws both); the output names files relative to the repository (or by file name), never by absolute path.
choices.ladder_curve: the D-90 ladder curve file (official repeat rule), Haiku-medium and Opus-medium whole-answer points.
choices.manifest_check: the run's manifest.json is required; its item_set_sha256 and n_items must equal the list the runner wrote, rebuilt by slim.manifest_requests (the trial round plus every test arm at its floor).
choices.one_try_pooled_interval: a one-try arm's pooled point uses Clopper-Pearson on x right of the 2n tries (§6: 'Clopper-Pearson for one-try arms').
choices.plan_as_run: the plan is the run folder's slim_plan.json; calibrated arms' max_tokens are the call log's calibration_limits line (cross-checked with calibration_limits.json); the scored rows are planned from the requests actually sent (slim.sent_test_requests); an arm in the cut line's cut_arms was never sent and is reported as 'cut by §7 (cost)' in §6, never as missing or 0%; a still-over cut needs the projection_accepted line.
choices.run_stopped_open_points: points §6 leaves open, as implemented: (a) the 'not sent (run stopped)' rule is applied per form too (a form with no final try has counts and no accuracy; the pooled as-deployed point still counts its missing tries wrong, as spec §4); (b) an arm of hx/om at a held length with no final try at all reads 'not sent (run stopped)' (nothing to describe); (c) the final-tries-only numbers (held hx/om and the sensitivity) use the same bootstrap names and seed as the as-deployed point, the same item 9b cost per answer (a designed try with no record at $0), and the CPC by item 9c's arithmetic (report_costs._cpc) over the final-tries scores; (d) the vote curve at a held N = 16 uses each base's final tries with k held to the tries left (as per_form's vote), a base with none left dropping out.
choices.run_stopped_section_6: spec §6 at 9c007e5 (lock-4 audit C1; Edith's pass-2 ruling): every §6 entry (arm blocks per form and pooled, effort figure, length curve, vote curve) carries designed / final / missing try counts (designed = the requests the run sent; a §7-cut arm stays 'cut by §7 (cost)' with no counts, as it was never sent). hx and om at a length the gate holds: final tries only, 'not completed; descriptive only'. No final try: 'not sent (run stopped)', no accuracy. Otherwise a missing try keeps the official as-deployed score with its counts, plus the exclude-missing view labelled 'sensitivity: missing tries excluded'.
choices.views_pooling: In refusals_out / truncations_out a base whose score is undefined in either form (every try of that form dropped) leaves that test in that view (Study 1: a dropped single answer drops the base); bases dropped are counted.
